## Overview

Using Chinese VAT administrative data, I study complementarities when upstream and downstream firms receive investment simultaneously. I examine how information frictions, financing constraints, and decentralized decision-making generate under-coordination, and whether government coordination and policy intervention can internalize production-network complementarities.
